description: List the peer reviews assigned to one submission within an assignment — a single submission can have more than one assigned reviewer — returning each review's id, assessor_id (the reviewer), user_id (the reviewee), asset_id, and workflow_state ('assigned' or 'completed'). Fetches every page (100 per request) and fails with a 'Results are incomplete' error instead of silently truncating. Use list_peer_reviews instead to see every review assigned across the whole assignment rather than one submission, create_peer_review to assign another reviewer to this submission, and delete_peer_review to remove one.
name: get_submission_peer_reviews
title: Get Submission Peer Reviews
